name: FuriosaAI RNGD (Renegade)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Vendor claims HBM (not publicly specified at a per-card bandwidth figure in the sources captured Oct-2026); the earlier Warboy used 66 GB/s LPDDR4x, RNGD moves to HBM for LLM serving.
notes: Added in the Phase-A gap-fill for the Oct-14 research ingest. RNGD is FuriosaAI's second-generation, LLM-oriented NPU (the part that actually targets transformer serving, unlike the vision-NPU Warboy). TSMC 5nm, 180W single PCIe card, mass production January 2026. Vendor ships a furiosa-llm pip package that serves OpenAI-compatible inference (furiosa-llm serve <model>). UNOBTAINIUM for a hobbyist: hardware access is request/eval only (furiosa.ai/signup, bare-metal or API-endpoint eval for enterprise), no retail channel, and no public tok/s table was published as of Oct-2026. Real serving stack, gated hardware - not a buyable cheap-inference card.
